annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 December 2023 on harmonised rules on fair access to and use of data and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/2394 and Directive (EU) 2020/1828 (Data Act)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 on harmonised rules on fair access to and use of data (Data Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L series)
annotation.summary_en: The EU Data Act is a binding regulation setting harmonised rules on access to and use of data generated by connected products (IoT) and related services. It gives users access and sharing rights, regulates B2B data sharing terms, public-sector access in exceptional need, cloud switching and interoperability. It has only incidental relevance to robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Users of connected products can access and share product and related-service data free of charge
Data holders must make data available to third parties on fair, reasonable, non-discriminatory terms
Unfair unilaterally imposed contractual terms on data access are non-binding for enterprises
Public sector bodies may request data in cases of exceptional need such as public emergencies
Providers of data processing services must enable switching and interoperability
